text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Morning. While discussing training plans 
with Victoire Pisa...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
――Hello, pardon the intrusion! Is Pisa 
here?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
I left the math handout in my room! Didn't 
you say it was due today?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
My, Earth! Thank you so much. I was just 
about to go back and get it.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: "Prego! I am glad to hear that."

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Even so, this part is an adagio, isn't it!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I can hear their Risonanza 
dell'Anima!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ah, yes, that's right—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"You two are such good friends," she said. 
At least, that's what I believe she was 
trying to convey.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Sì! Pisa's ear is truly that of a 
virtuoso!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At lunchtime that day. On my way back to 
the Trainer's office, I bumped into 
Victoire Pisa and the others.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: ""OOL". Neo Universe requests resupply."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I believe she's simply "hungry." ...If 
you'd like, why don't the three of us eat 
together today?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Affirmative. "Space Weather Forecast." 
Today, "Gliese" is shining brightly.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"My, a limited-time menu item? In that 
case, we must hurry over."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days later. The two of them came 
over while Victoire Pisa wasn't 
around—however...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
And so, would you care to join in the 
terzetto! Direttore!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
And so, would you care to join in the 
terzetto! Direttrice!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
""REQU". Neo Universe also requests 
"RCOL"."
choice_data_list: (I-I don't get it! I don't get it at all!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Thermite? Recall? I have no idea what 
you're talking about...!"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Could it be a cacophony? If so, I'll come 
back another day!"

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: "Mission Control," standing by.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: "—My apologies. I am late."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Earth-san, Universe-san. Is something 
the matter?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Pisa! I came by to invite you to our 
terzetto!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Rendezvous." Victoire Pisa, affirmative 
too?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my, all three of us running side by 
side? That sounds lovely!
choice_data_list:
So that was an invitation to train 
side-by-side...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
...Ah! Oddio! My apologies, it seems I was 
playing a cacophony.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Without thinking, I ended up speaking just 
like I do when Pisa is around.
choice_data_list: No, I'm sorry I didn't realize

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Still, Victoire Pisa's conversational 
comprehension is truly remarkable."
choice_data_list: Is there a trick to it?
Is there a trick to it?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
A trick, is it...? Umm... what could it 
be?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Aether." With Victoire Pisa, I was able 
to "connect" from the very beginning.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: ..."Landing Failure."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Did you buy the wrong one by mistake? I'd 
be happy to exchange it for you.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
My name is Sounds of Earth! I'd be 
thrilled if we could perform a duo, poco a 
poco!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
My name is Victoire Pisa. ...Hearing you 
say that makes me very happy. I look 
forward to being good friends.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Pisa-san's melodía is a miraculous tune 
capable of harmonizing with all creation!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Victoire Pisa is a "Connector." ...Neo 
Universe always carries "gratitude" for 
her.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Oh my... To have you say something like 
that to me...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"No, thank you very much. ...If you'd 
like, please feel free to come chat with 
me again."

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Certo! Pisa-san really is so modesta!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Yeah, it's 'MDST.'

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I definitely understood what that meant 
just now. This is..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I definitely understood what that meant 
just now. This is..."

text_block_list.name: The Three
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Um... I believe that was meant to be 
"humble" or something along those lines...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"No, you're absolutely right! Pisa-san is 
an angelo playing harmonies!"

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Neo Universe "agrees" as well.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: ! "Connect".

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Ah, what magnificent harmony!
choice_data_list: That means I got it right, doesn't it!
That means I got it right, right!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: My, ufufu!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Trainer, you're part of our circle too♪
